title: XP Battler not appearing in game for a specific actor.

posts.author: GrenAxolotl
posts.body:
So, I've encountered an issue within RPG Maker XP, where even if I have a 'battler' image assigned to an actor, in this case, actor 1, it will not appear in game?
It appears in 'test battles' with the actor, but specifically when I'm in the playtest that it doesn't show up.
Would anyone know how I could solve this issue aside from just, using a different actor slot? I tested this with actor 9 and it seemed to work.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
The difference between battle test and ingame battles is that the battletest skips the full game initialisation to get to the battlescreen directly.
And that is known to invalidate those scripts that need the full initialization to function correctly, making the battletest less reliable in case of using such scripts.
While your effect seems to do the opposite at first, what really happens is something different here:
One of the scripts you're using results in that image being unable to be used, and battletest invalidates that script that is causing this.
So you'll have to check your added scripts if they are all configured correctly or might cause an incompatibility or some other errors.

posts.author: GrenAxolotl
posts.body:
ahhh okay. thanks. I'll go and check them.
Update: Nevermind, it was my really poor coding which I didn't check that was causing the issue. Thanks for the help anyways.
